db_instance_id.description: The ID of the PolarDBX instance for which the manual backup was created.

i18n.zh-Hans: 已创建手动备份的PolarDB-X实例的ID。
i18n.en-US: The ID of the PolarDB-X instance for which the manual backup was created.

backup_set_id.description: The ID of the backup set created by the manual backup.

i18n.zh-Hans: 手动备份创建的备份集ID。
i18n.en-US: The ID of the backup set created by the manual backup.

backup_status.description: The status of the manual backup. Valid values: 0 (creating), 1 (success), 2 (failed).

i18n.zh-Hans: 手动备份的状态。有效值：0（创建中）、1（成功）、2（失败）。
i18n.en-US: The status of the manual backup. Valid values: 0 (creating), 1 (success), 2 (failed).
